title: Get available locations by advertiser ID
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get available locations that your ads can be delivered to **based on your advertiser IDs**.
If you want to get available locations that your ads can be delivered to based on your objectives, placements, and optionally targeting operating systems, and brand safety settings, use the [/tool/region/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?rid=7xusz43oh3h&id=1737189539571713) endpoint. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/search/region/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | advertiser_id {Required} | string | Advertiser ID. | | language | string | The language you want the returned region name to be translated into. Default value: `en`
Currently, we only support `zh`, `fr`, `es`, `ko`, `vi`, `en`, `hi`, `it`, `tr`, `ru`, `ja`, `id`, `de`, `ms`, `ar`, and `th`

Note: If you do not pass in one of the supported values above, it will return as the default `en`.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/search/region/' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --data-raw '{ "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "language": "ja" }' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |data|object|Returned data.| #|region_list|object[]|List of all available regions. | ##|region_id|string|Region ID.| ##|region_name|string|Region name. | ##|region_level|string|Region level. Enum values: `COUNTRY`(country or region level), `PROVINCE`, `CITY`, `DISTRICT`.
DMA and metropolitans are at the province level.| ##|country_code|string|Country code for the country of the region.| ##|parent_id|string|The upper-level region id. This field will not be returned if `region_level` is `COUNTRY`.| ##|area_type|string|Location type. Enum values: `ADMIN`, `METROPOLITAN_OR_DMA`.| ##|support_below_18|boolean|Whether the location supports ads to be delivered to people under 18 years of age.| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "region_list": [ { "region_level": "COUNTRY", "support_below_18": true, "country_code": "US", "area_type": "ADMIN", "region_id": "6252001", "region_name": "アメリカ" }, { "region_level": "COUNTRY", "support_below_18": true, "country_code": "EC", "area_type": "ADMIN", "region_id": "3658394", "region_name": "エクアドル" }, { "region_level": "COUNTRY", "support_below_18": true, "country_code": "QA", "area_type": "ADMIN", "region_id": "289688", "region_name": "カタール" }, … ] } } (/code) ```
